other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Frequency Encoding on Full Dataset
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is applied to the concatenated train and test datasets, which leaks the distribution of categories in the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage: Target Encoding Validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Out-of-fold target encoding is performed prior to the cross-validation loop using the exact same KFold splits. During model training, the target encodings in the training fold contain information derived from the targets of the validation fold, causing severe data leakage into the evaluation.

summary: The agent implements a structured machine learning pipeline with appropriate model choices, feature engineering, and cross-validation. However, the solution suffers from severe data leakage: frequency encoding is computed on the combined train and test sets, and target encoding is performed using the same KFold object as the training loop, leaking validation targets into the training features. Furthermore, the final ensemble relies on arbitrary, untuned weights.
